THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Rൾඏඈർൺඍංඈඇ Uඇൽൾඋ Sൾർඍංඈඇ 39(1)

BY the Order made under Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 414/10 dated 13th August, 1986 the allotments of Land speciﬁ ed morefully in the Order No. 350 of 1986 dated 29.07.1986 had been vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. But the possession of the allotments of land hereinunder described has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke only the allotments of
lands given in the following schedule to the aforesaid order No. 350 of 1986 dated 29.07.1986, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 414/10 dated 13.08.1986.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No. : 03J/80/LG/773. Divisional Secretary’s No. : l;r$3$2$t,atA$ 227. Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.07th, February 2024.
